newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ahold in 50/50 joint venture in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Ahold in 50/50 joint venture in Spain.

text.p: Dutch supermarkets group Ahold NV said on Tuesday it had closed a 50/50 joint venture in Spain with Barcelona-based Caprabo.
It said the joint venture, dubbed Store 2000, would develop supermarket and hypermarket chains throughout Spain.
"It's first activity is the takeover of 10 supermarkets in Madrid from Alfaro SA", Ahold said in a statement.
No financial details of the deal were given.
Caprabo SA was founded in 1959 and operates 90 supermarkets and hypermarkets with total sales of 85 billion pesetas and a staff of 3,500.
"Caprabo brings to the joint venture their local retail experience, quality management and excellent marketing skills," said Ahold executive board memeber Fritz Ahlqvist.
"These elements, combined with Ahold's international know-how and financial resources, make a great start for expansion into a large country with considerable growth potential."
Caprabo's managing Director Silvio Elias said the joint venture was looking for acquisitions and attractive sites for store development in various formats.
"We see a great future for the new joint venture with many jobs at local level," he said.
